gaps: human_buddy_email is not set - Human Buddy has not been assigned yet for this hire (per framework part D §13, this is always a fresh per-hire decision from manager intake, not inherited). Office tour used a fallback guide (Tal Harari, teammate at the same Tel Aviv office) instead - see officeTourGuide resolution.

hrbp_email is not set for this employee, so no 'meeting with your HRBP' item was scheduled. Plausibly intentional - she is herself part of the HRBP function - but that is not confirmed anywhere in the data, so it's flagged rather than assumed.

The Teams catalog has no entry for 'People Partners' (team lookup returned null) - team mission and core_tools are unknown. The two team-member intros (Rachel Cooper, Tal Harari) and the department-overview grounding used real employee-table records matching team='People Partners' and department.mission/primary_kpis directly, not the missing team record - same class of real, non-invented data, just from a different table than usual.
company_overview only has basic summary fields (name, category, employee count, offices) - no product description, ICP, or business-model detail exists anywhere in the source data.
DEMO ASSUMPTION (see prompts/process-expert.md): business-track LMS sessions 3-6 have no real source data behind them - descriptions are topical only.
No manager intake was supplied for this run, so professionalMentor is null - no mentor name invented; this is a pipeline limitation for this test run, not a fact about the employee.

Her 9-person portfolio (peopleSupported) is scheduled as 9 separate individual 1:1s, spread across weeks 3-6 - not a group session. The headcount>=6 group-meeting rule applies only to real team_member intros (people sharing this employee's own team_id, an existing team that already meets together) - a portfolio/cross-team contact list is structurally different and is never grouped, regardless of size. This also means the CEO, CPO and CRO are never bundled into a shared session with each other or with the Finance/IT/Legal/Ops managers in her portfolio.
This agent does not generate applied 'doing' work tickets (out of scope by design) - actual work assignments should come from the employee's manager/portfolio backlog, not this plan.
